title: The LED Traffic Light and the Danger of "But Sometimes!"
summary: Technology Connections explains how LED traffic lights, which do not melt snow, drew complaints and were blamed for accidents. He uses it to illustrate the 'but sometimes' fallacy against new technology.
why: Cited constantly as the name and example of the 'but sometimes' argument, where edge cases are used to resist better technology such as EVs and solar.
topic: led traffic lights and technology criticism

quote.text: I love Technology Connections' take on this line of argument [0]
